name: Tamsin
bio: Sketches every tree and stream on the procedural island of Island Walker. Every island is new to her too.

portrait.subject: a cute young naturalist explorer with a sun hat, a sketchbook under her arm, a pencil behind her ear and a tiny bird on her shoulder
portrait.background: soft green island trees and blue sky

request: Hi! Tamsin here. I'm mapping the islands in Island Walker. Walk with me? 🏝️
hello: Every reload is a new island. Isn't that wonderful?
about: I'm Tamsin. I walk the islands and draw what I see. No two islands are ever the same!
how: Just walk. Explore the procedural island: forest, streams, caves, ruins. Every seed makes a new island.
tips: Follow streams. They often lead to something nice.
Climb a hill to see the whole island.
Caves are dark but worth a peek!
chat: Drew a tree today. It looked like every tree. I love it anyway.
Found a waterfall. Stayed for an hour.
The clouds here are generated too. Still pretty.
A bird followed me home. It's my bird now.
nudge: A new island is waiting. Want to walk?
Sunset's coming on the island. Come watch?
idle: {ago} since our last walk! The island's been growing.
I sketched {ago} worth of trees waiting for you!
update: Island Walker updated to v{version}! New islands to explore!
